speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are concerned about a skin lesion that may have oncologic implications. Can you please describe the lesion in detail, including its appearance, location, and how long it has been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that detailed history. Given the chronic, non-healing nature of these lesions and their resistance to previous treatments, have you noticed any bleeding, pain, or rapid changes in the size or shape of the sores?

Additionally, do you have any history of genital warts or other sexually transmitted infections, and have you ever noticed any swollen lymph nodes in your groin or armpits?
